author: XBOX
description:
When Dodo’s dream of becoming an actor falls apart, the young duck returns home to Mirth Island in search of a new purpose.

There, he discovers that the legendary theater that first inspired him has been left in ruins. Together with his childhood friends Vivi and Rita, Dodo sets out to restore the theater and bring its stage back to life.

Explore a colorful island filled with charming locals, adorable animals, and stories waiting to be discovered. Help the islanders with their everyday problems, form meaningful friendships, and enjoy playful rhythm minigames along the way.

Through perseverance, friendship, and small acts of kindness, Dodo may discover that rebuilding the theater could also help him heal his own heart.
